findings.evidence: InducedQuiver.totalHomMap at InducedQuiver.lean:89 sums hom inclusions. With all hom modules zero it is injective even for noninjective F, all operations intertwine, and zero functor components satisfy the equations into the original total algebra. FullSubquiver.totalHomMap_injective also supplies an injective specialization of the map described unconditionally at Induced.lean:30.
findings.fix: Qualify all these claims with “in general” or “need not”; describe the induced construction as avoiding obstructions that can occur.
findings.issue: Lines 25–33 categorically exclude the original total algebra as a target and assert noninjectivity and intertwining only on composable strings; InducedQuiver.lean:25 likewise claims noninjective F forces a noninjective totalHomMap. These claims exclude valid special cases.

summary: The module documentation overstates the obstructions associated with noninjective object maps.
